library.title: Record a disciplinary decision
library.intro: What the decision-maker states when a conduct case is decided: the findings on each allegation, the outcome the law provides, the provision relied on and the reasons. The decision is made and sealed in the case by an official who can sign, different from the one who proposed it. Restricted to the regulator; what the public register shows is what the law allows.
library.filled_by: The official or panel with the power to decide, signed in; a different official proposed it (four-eyes).
library.authority: The regulator that keeps the chosen profession's register (lib/professions/register.ts, profession().authority), under the approved permit authority mapping of the profession's permit type; never a ministry by name.

nation_values.decision: The days to appeal a disciplinary decision.

deviations.what: The decision is made and sealed by the case engine (prof.fitness "suspend", "revoke" or "close", four-eyes), never by submitting this form; the form records what the decision-maker states
deviations.why: Every decision cites the law version and is signed with the decision key; AI never makes a legally material decision.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: cases change only through lib/casework/engine.ts

deviations.what: No disciplinary outcome ships in the list
deviations.why: The platform never invents a decision power; the outcomes are the nation's law.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: never hardcode a power

deviations.what: Patient consent, emergency clinical access and a shared patient reference do not arise: the form carries no patient, clinical, treatment, diagnosis or individual health field
deviations.why: Allowed scope only: health facility and professional regulation and aggregate statistics.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
